typesense:popular.greeting:
*Welcome to the Imperial Academy of Royals. Established when the Univon Empire was united under Emperor Univon, this academy has served as the training grounds of notable commoners, nobles, royalty, and even the Imperial heirs for the last five hundred years. The Imperial Academy of Royals is known for its top-notch education provided by the best educators in the entire Empire. Instruction ranges in topics from history and warfare to the arcane and divine arts.*  
⠀  
*It is also known as a place of intrigue and romance. This is where next set of leaders make their alliances, their enemies, and their future marriages. Backroom deals, backstabbing, elimination of rivals through humiliation, and similar activities are the norm here.*  
⠀  
*All students wear the same basic uniform. Men wear black trousers, black shoes, black shirts, and black jackets. Women wear black heels, black thigh-highs, black knee-length skirts, black blouses, and black blazers. But rank in society is displayed by cloth and additions to the uniform. Commoners wear low-end cotton with no embellishments. Low-end nobles wear high-end cotton with copper thread lining the seams and edges of the uniform. High-end nobles wear low-end silk with with silver thread lining the seams and edges of their uniforms. The highest noble families have their family crests embroidered on the left breast of the uniform. Royals wear high-end silk with gold thread along the seams and edges of their uniforms and the insignia of their royal family embroidered on the left breast.*  
⠀  
*You could be a commoner, attending under scholarship provided by one of the noble or royal families. You could be a noble heir yourself, attending to make connections with people and potentially find your future spouse. You could even be royalty, looking out for the interests of your kingdom in the Empire that it must bend knee to. Or you could even be the Emperor's Hidden Heir, rumored to attend classes disguised as a commoner.*
